messages:
maria_g: Quick follow-up on the allocator/evict design from last week's RFC. I prototyped a very small change to use a 'compaction watermark' instead of periodic compaction.

ben_l: nice, what's the watermark?

maria_g: we measure live fragmentation as fragmented_bytes / total_allocated_bytes per GPU. if > 25% for > 30s we trigger compaction on that GPU. The idea is avoid frequent work for short-lived spikes.

chao_w: how are you measuring fragmented_bytes? is that free holes between active allocations or something inferred from slab metadata?

maria_g: using slab metadata + a fast estimate from page-refcounts. code snippet:

```
// prometheus-ish
frag_ratio = sum(frag_free_bytes{gpu="$GPU"}) / sum(allocated_bytes{gpu="$GPU"})
```

irene_p: 25% seems arbitrary. needs perf runs. Also compaction cost could spike tail latency.

maria_g: agreed. prototype has compaction run at background priority and we check SLO headroom before starting. if tail latency budget < 5ms we delay.

ops-bot: deploy reported: compaction-worker scaled to 3 replicas on staging

ben_l: tradeoff question: compaction vs eviction+spill. compaction reduces fragmentation for repeated small allocations, eviction frees hot pages but costs transfer.

chao_w: I think the boundary should be: compaction for intra-GPU fragmentation (cheap memcpy on device), eviction/spill when we need host memory or persistent free capacity. That way we avoid PCIe churn for small gains.

maria_g: exactly. compaction does device-side memmove where possible. eviction is last-resort and follows cost model: estimated transfer cost vs expected allocation lifetime.

irene_p: can we expose frag_ratio and compaction events in the console? would help ops tune thresholds per workload.

maria_g: yes. adding metrics: frag_ratio, compaction_count_total, compaction_duration_seconds, compaction_bytes_moved, eviction_count_total, eviction_cost_estimate.

ben_l: let's also add per-model heatmaps so we can correlate fragmentation with model token lengths.

maria_g: agreed. i'll add a lightweight annotator that tags allocations by model_id when enabled.

chao_w: long-term: we should refactor allocator to be two-level: global slab pools + per-stream bump allocators. that will reduce cross-stream fragmentation.

irene_p: +1 for two-level. but big refactor. we should make it feature-flagged and roll gradually.

maria_g: plan: land metric instrumentation first, then background compaction, then per-stream annotations, then refactor as opt-in API.

ben_l: timeline? can we get metrics in staging next week?

maria_g: yes, I'll push a PR today. staging by Friday.

chao_w: want me to review the compaction logic? I can look tomorrow.

maria_g: please, thanks. tagging @chao_w :thumbsup:

irene_p: fine with rollout plan. keep an eye on dedicated customers who pin latency.

ops-bot: note: created ticket INF-712 for compaction metrics + UI

maria_g: thanks all. follow-up in #eng-runtime next week with results.
